about_the_game:
Soundtracks of Leonardo’s Island – Origins
Composed by William Dodson

This free soundtrack package contains four original tracks from the game:

  • 🎵 First Day Theme – captures the bright and uplifting atmosphere of daytime exploration.

  • 🌙 First Night Theme – a calm and mysterious tune for nighttime moments.

  • ⚔️ First Battle Theme – energetic and intense

  • 🏗️ First Construction Theme – steady and rhythmic, enhancing the mood of building and creation.

Each track is approximately 3 minutes long, composed exclusively for Leonardo’s Island – Origins.
